title: Juicy Herbal Mediterranean King Prawns Yakimono-Grill
description: A flavorful and healthy Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring succulent king prawns grilled to perfection with a blend of aromatic herbs and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (around 400°F).
Rinse the king prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the oregano, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Brush the extra virgin olive oil on both sides of the king prawns and sprinkle with the oregano mixture.
Grill the king prawns for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Transfer the king prawns to a plate and let them rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
